Thinking about buying Adidas Forum Lows? Here’s what you should know before you cop 👟 1️⃣ Sizing & fit: Forum Lows generally run true to size with a slightly roomy, structured fit. They have a firm sole and classic padded upper, so they feel supportive but not super soft or flexible compared to modern cushioned sneakers. 2️⃣ Function vs fashion: Originally designed as a basketball shoe in the ‘80s, Forums were built for ankle support, durability, and court stability. Today, they’re worn almost entirely as a lifestyle sneaker, loved for their vintage look rather than athletic performance. 3️⃣ Style category: Forum Lows sit in the “retro streetwear / vintage sporty” lane. They’re typically styled with straight-leg denim, cargos, oversized basics, and throwback-inspired fits. If you like classic, timeless sneakers with a true retro feel, they’re an easy addition to your rotation. If you prefer lightweight, ultra-cushioned shoes, they may feel a bit stiff.
